approved.en: Russia continues missile and sabotage attacks inside Ukraine, including a ballistic strike on Kyiv that killed one civilian and injured fourteen, and a fire near a weapons factory blamed on a Russia-run network. Ukrainian forces are conducting deep-strike missions up to 2,500 km, hitting a missile-battery plant in Yelets and a chemical plant in Voronezh, and are evacuating wounded soldiers by drone. A US-brokered ceasefire is now in effect in the occupied city of Oleshky, where residents previously survived on weeds. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Russland fortsetter missil- og sabotasjeangrep inne i Ukraina, inkludert et ballistisk angrep på Kyiv som drepte én sivil og såret fjorten, og en brann nær en våpenfabrikk som ble lagt skylden på et Russland-drevet nettverk. Ukrainske styrker gjennomfører dype angrep på opptil 2 500 km, og treffer et missilbatterifabrikk i Yelets og et kjemisk anlegg i Voronezh, og evakuerer sårede soldater med droner. En US-meglet våpenhvile er nå i kraft i den okkuperte byen Oleshky, hvor innbyggerne tidligere overlevde på ugress. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Israeli election sees record turnout, with Palestinians in the West Bank fearing further violence if Netanyahu remains prime minister and some uncertain whether to vote or boycott. Settlers are looking beyond Netanyahu to the far right, and Arab parties accuse Netanyahu of inciting hatred to scare voters. The conflict has produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran is intensifying threats to the region, urging the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. Qatar is urging Iran to end these threats and reopen the strait, while Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials are preparing talks with Iran to defuse tensions. The United States is considering renewed strikes on Iran, driving oil prices above $117 a barrel. Iran’s Supreme Leader and top security chief discussed war and Hormuz, and the Saudi-led coalition reported downing Houthi missiles and drones aimed at the kingdom. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Iran intensiverer truslene mot regionen, og oppfordrer til gjenåpning av Hormuzstredet mens houthi-missiler og droner fortsetter å treffe saudiske oljanlegg og flyplasser, noe som fører til at Riyadh-flyplassen åpnes igjen etter flere ukers forstyrrelser. Qatar oppfordrer Iran til å avslutte disse truslene og gjenåpne stredet, mens saudiske, tyrkiske og pakistanske tjenestemenn forbereder samtaler med Iran for å dempe spenningene. USA vurderer nye angrep mot Iran, noe som driver oljeprisene over 117 dollar per fat. Irans øverste leder og topp sikkerhetssjef diskuterte krig og Hormuz, og den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen rapporterte at de skjøt ned houthi-missiler og droner rettet mot kongeriket. 123 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Houthis have intensified attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking the Ras Tanura oil refinery, oil pumping stations and Riyadh airport, while Saudi air defenses have intercepted missiles and drones. In response, the Saudi-led coalition has destroyed Houthi missile facilities and launch sites in Yemen. Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan have agreed to hold additional talks on the conflict, and Egypt's parliament has authorized military aid to Saudi Arabia. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Som svar har den Saudi-ledede koalisjonen ødelagt houthienes missilanlegg og oppskytingssteder i Jemen. Iran, Saudi-Arabia, Tyrkia og Pakistan har blitt enige om å holde ytterligere samtaler om konflikten, og Egypts parlament har godkjent militærhjelp til Saudi-Arabia. Konflikten forårsaket 918 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Jordan has again carried out airstrikes in Syria, saying they targeted Islamic State hideouts linked to a recent church attack that killed nine people, but the strikes also hit civilian areas, prompting Syrian condemnation as a breach of airspace. Syrian authorities report civilian casualties from the Jordanian attacks. The Jordanian government maintains the operations are aimed at militants, while families of the victims deny any connection to the church attack. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syriske myndigheter rapporterer sivile tap som følge av de jordanske angrepene. Den jordanske regjeringen opprettholder at operasjonene er rettet mot militante, mens familiene til ofrene benekter enhver forbindelse til kirkearrestet. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi courts have sentenced six French nationals to life imprisonment and a seventh to 15 years for Islamic State membership, while another court imposed lengthy terms on seven French citizens for the same crime. Security forces have repeatedly intercepted unidentified drones over Baghdad's Green Zone, with multiple incidents reported. Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and three militia groups have pledged to disarm by June 2027. Iran has intensified rhetoric warning the United States, and the United States has warned Baghdad it will strike Iraqi militias that join Iran's war. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sikkerhetsstyrker har gjentatte ganger avskåret uidentifiserte droner over Bagdads grønne sone, og flere hendelser er rapportert. Yazidimilitære enheter knyttet til PKK blir avrustet og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og tre militsgrupper har lovet å avrustes innen juni 2027. Iran har skjerpet retorikken og advart USA, og USA har advart Bagdad om at de vil slå mot irakiske militsgrupper som slutter seg til Irans krig. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Intensified drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces have hit Nyala, killing at least 21 people, injuring 40 and knocking out power in southeast Sudan, worsening civilian hardship. The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied militias continue to grind the conflict, while women under siege are increasingly acting as frontline responders to meet basic needs. Hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees are now hosted in Chad as the regional humanitarian emergency expands. The United Nations warns of a looming famine risk as the war grinds on, and the conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Coordinated cattle raids in Warrup state killed at least 72 people, while a drone strike on a market in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73. President Kiir reshuffled the South Sudan Revenue Authority board, reinstating two commissioners after a cancelled order, and the Bar Association launched a roadmap to improve access to justice. The government partnered with Israel's Gilat to provide nationwide satellite internet and secured a UNESCO world-heritage nomination for the Boma-Bandingilo inscription. Governor Dollar promoted the reintegration of IDPs and returnees, and the U.S. Embassy remembered staff who died supporting South Sudanese people. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Somali army convoys continue to be ambushed by al-Shabaab near Baidoa, while al-Shabaab suffered heavy losses in Operation Banooda and a Bay operation that reportedly killed 75 fighters. Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor and Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and a town in Bay, extending combat in the south. Ethiopia has withdrawn over 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict. US forces have been accused of weaponising floods by trapping women and children in the path of El Niño. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Fitgharan-styrkene kontrollerer nå korridoren Mogadishu-Baidoa og Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba og en by i Bay, og utvider kampene i sør. Etiopia har trukket tilbake over 3 000 soldater og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State. Amerikanske styrker er blitt anklaget for å våpenisere flommer ved å fange kvinner og barn i El Niños bane. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In eastern Nigeria gunmen killed at least ten people, and in the northeast a mass shooting in Binnari left dozens injured. Kidnappers abducted six residents in Kaduna's Millennium City estate and three vigilantes died in a separate Plateau incident. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: A machete-wielding mob killed a nurse and wounded a health worker while they responded to an Ebola alert in eastern DRC, prompting Uganda to tighten its border as the outbreak spread. Rebel forces captured weapons from fleeing DRC troops and Burundian troops, while DRC forces recaptured strategic territory from a rebel group led by an ex-president. Nigerian President Tinubu called for stronger African defence cooperation as the death toll from a separate attack in Taraba rose to 58. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Opprørsstyrker tok våpen fra flyktende DRC-tropp og burundiske soldater, mens DRC-styrker gjenerobret strategisk territorium fra en opprørsgruppe ledet av en tidligere president. Nigerias president Tinubu oppfordret til sterkere afrikansk forsvarssamarbeid da dødstallet fra et separat angrep i Taraba steg til 58. approved.en: Cameroon’s BIR rapid-intervention force has expanded its presence around Lake Chad while drones and joint border patrols continue targeting Anglophone separatists in the Northwest and Southwest, where attacks on government forces persist. Survivors of the 2016 Eseka rail disaster remain without justice a decade after the crash, and a French court has authorized a third-party funder to enforce an ICC award against the state. The Supreme Court halted the appeal of a former minister sentenced for embezzlement, and a Cameroonian scholar has called for new peace talks with Anglophone separatists. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Cameroons BIR-raske intervensjonsstyrke har utvidet sin tilstedeværelse rundt Tsjad-sjøen mens droner og felles grensepatruljer fortsetter å målrette anglofonse separatister i Nordvest og Sørvest, hvor angrep på regjeringsstyrker vedvarer. Overlevende fra Eseka-togkatastrofen i 2016 er fortsatt uten rettferdighet et tiår etter ulykken, og en fransk domstol har gitt en tredjepartsfinansier tillatelse til å håndheve en ICC-dømmesum mot staten.
